hook: One rook. One move. Pass it on.
text: One rook. One move. Pass it on. ♟️ White to move. Mate in one. Find the move before you open the spoiler. Then forward this position to a chess friend and compare how you spotted the back-rank pattern. No sign-up is needed to solve the card. Answer: Ra8#. The rook controls the eighth rank; Black’s own pawns block the escape squares. For your next challenge, explore the Academy in Web3Chess.
